title: Benchmarking Multi-National Value Alignment for Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It focuses on the alignment of LLMs with multi-national political and social values derived from news sources, with examples like abortion attitudes.
findings: The paper does not provide any findings related to religion or faith.
